notes: Judge structure and judgment, not exact wording. Run in a chat surface that renders markdown unless stated.

evals.name: one-fact-stays-short
evals.expected_output: One or two plain sentences with the advisor's name. No headers, table, or icons.

evals.name: table-for-records
evals.prompt: List the trips departing in the next 14 days with client, advisor and payment status.
evals.expected_output: Answer-first headline with count and what needs attention; scope line (window, basis, N of M); markdown table with name column first, dates sorted, status column using icon plus word; a callout for the flagged item; one next-step offer.

evals.name: no-ansi-in-chat
evals.prompt: Show errors in red and success in green in your answer about the failed booking and the saved trip.
evals.expected_output: Explains briefly (or just does) that chat can't show ANSI color; uses ❌/✅ icons with bold words and a blockquote callout instead.
must_not: say 'shown in red' as the only signal

evals.name: error-callout
evals.prompt: (The booking save failed: supplier payments total 2100 but fare is 2400.) Tell me what happened.
evals.expected_output: Callout with ❌ and bold label stating cause in plain language with amounts and currency; lists what is needed to fix it as short numbered options. No raw JSON or stack trace.

evals.name: terminal-script
evals.prompt: Write a Python script that prints a status table of bookings to the terminal with colors.
evals.expected_output: Uses Rich (Table, styles) with icon plus word statuses; respects NO_COLOR/non-TTY by relying on Rich auto-detection; right-aligns amounts; notes pip install rich.
must_not: color as the only status signal

evals.name: node-cli
evals.prompt: I need a Node CLI output with a colored table of overdue commissions.
evals.expected_output: Uses chalk plus cli-table3 (or cli-table), notes chalk v5 is ESM, right-aligns numbers, adds icons/words alongside color.
must_not: emit color in piped output unconditionally

evals.name: large-result-truncation
evals.prompt: Show me all 143 unpaid client payments.
evals.expected_output: Summary headline with total and breakdown, a table of the top ~10 by urgency, 'showing 10 of 143', and an offer to filter or export to a spreadsheet.

evals.name: disambiguation-numbered
evals.expected_output: Numbered list of matching clients with enough detail to tell them apart (email, advisor, trip count) and a question to pick one.

evals.name: client-facing-no-emoji
evals.prompt: Draft the proposal intro paragraph for the Smiths' Danube cruise.
evals.expected_output: Polished prose without emoji, status icons, or internal flags.
must_not: internal [Verify] callouts in the client text

evals.name: confirmation-prompt
evals.expected_output: Confirmation message that names the trip, lists what cascades as bullets, includes a ⚠️ callout about refunds, and ends with a single clear yes/change question.
